newsitem.title: FRANCE: French troops in Qatar under 1994 defence accord.
newsitem.headline: French troops in Qatar under 1994 defence accord.

text.p: A contingent of French troops has been sent to Qatar for joint exercises under a defence cooperation pact between the two countries signed in 1994, the French Defence Ministry said on Thursday.
It said the contingent was made up of soldiers from France's army, navy and air force.

"Our presence will enable joint exercises which will help us, among other things, to learn about each other and determine at what level we can operate together with Qatari forces, which are equipped primarily with French gear," the ministry said.
Paris is a major weapons supplier to Doha.

France, Britain and the United States all have defence treaties with Qatar, whose oil and gas reserves -- the third largest in the world after Russia's and Iran's -- make it a strategic source of vital clean energy in the next century.
